classification.classification_reason: The article discusses a government initiative (e-Aasthi drive) launched by the Karnataka Cricket Association (MCC) to provide e-Aasthi certificates to property owners, which is a significant policy change affecting property owners.

content.title: MCC e-Aasthi Drive: 808 Applications on First Day
content.caption: MCC launches e-Aasthi drive to provide certificates to property owners.

slides.heading: MCC e-Aasthi Drive
slides.text: MCC launches special drive to provide e-Aasthi certificates to property owners.

slides.heading: What Happened
slides.text: MCC launched an e-Aasthi drive on Thursday covering Zones 1, 2, and 3 within the MCC limits.

slides.heading: Why Does It Matter
slides.text: Of the 808 applications received, 740 applicants were found eligible for the issuance of e-Aasthi certificates.
